name: Les Moulins du Lauragais
notes: Family flour mill in the Lauragais, plain wheat between Toulouse and Castelnaudary. Label Rouge traditional flours, T45 to T130. Full semi-trailer delivery twice a week.

name: Moulin de l'Arrats
notes: Small stone-grinding mill in the Gers: organic T65, T80, T150 flours and petit épeautre. Limited volumes, possible shortage at the end of the season.

name: Beurrerie Coopérative de Saintonge
notes: AOP Charentes-Poitou dairy cooperative: 84% laminating butter, unsalted and lightly salted butter. Monthly allocations in periods of tension (November–January), prices indexed to the butter quotation.

name: Laiterie de la Garonne
notes: Regional dairy: UHT cream and thick cream, milk, 82% pastry butter and standard laminating butter. Daily delivery, very reliable.

name: Les Œufs de la Montagne Noire
notes: Free-range hen farm at the foot of the Montagne Noire and partner egg-breaking plant for liquid egg products. Less laying in winter, avian flu = risk of shortage.

name: Cacaos & Couvertures Garonne
notes: Importer and processor of couverture chocolate: dark, milk and white pistoles, baker's sticks, praline, cocoa. In-store demonstrations for pastry chefs.

name: Sud Fruits Secs Import
notes: Marseille importer: almond powder, dried fruit, candied fruit, vanilla, orange blossom. Low prices but negotiable, lead times slipping in December.

name: Ingrédients Boulangers du Midi
notes: Baking-ingredients wholesaler in Saint-Jory: fresh and dry yeast, improvers, sugars, glazes, pastry mixes, margarines. Delivery every night.

name: Viennoiserie des Pyrénées
notes: Raw frozen all-butter viennoiserie, puff pastry and par-baked baguette manufacturer. Delivery in a -20 °C lorry twice a week.

name: Primeurs du Carreau de Fondeyre

contacts.name: Didier Maffre
contacts.role: Wholesale Trader at the loading bay

notes: Wholesaler at the Toulouse MIN next door: strawberries, raspberries, apples, pears and lemons for pastry chefs. Bought day to day.

name: Garonne Pack Emballages
notes: Food packaging manufacturer and distributor: bread bags, viennoiserie bags, pastry boxes, cake boards, baking paper, galette crowns and galette des rois charms.
